content:
alex-gm: Heads-up: CloudMart metering v2 started sending events with unit="ms_cpu" overnight. Our pricing layer treated it as seconds -> 1000x overcount in some accounts.
priya-partners: yikes. which customers affected? any live invoices already generated?
alex-gm: preliminary filter shows ~12 customers in eu-central with usage in the 00:00-03:00 UTC window. No invoices posted yet but daily billable snapshots used for some quota gating.
marketplace-bot: alert: metering-ingest (cloudmart-v2) 10k invalid-unit events detected between 2091233980-2091234040. sample: 
```json
{"customer_id":"cust-42","usage_id":"u-9a8","meter":{"unit":"ms_cpu","value":240000}}
```
leah-billing: confirm: our tariff table expects unit codes: cpu_seconds, gpu_minutes, token_chars. We have a unit_map but not ms_cpu.
tom-eng: CloudMart docs claimed "ms_cpu = milliseconds of CPU time". We should map ms_cpu -> cpu_seconds with factor 0.001 before price calc.
priya-partners: can we hotfix ingest transformer to apply conversion and add a telemetry tag so we can track retro replays?
tom-eng: yes. plan: 1) reject unknown units to DLQ (short term), 2) apply deterministic conversion for ms_cpu -> cpu_seconds, 3) add header X-Partner-Unit=MAPPED and idempotency key. I'll open PR.
leah-billing: retroactive impact: run a reconciliation over last 48h for customers with cloudmart vendor_id. If billed amount delta > $50 we should auto-create adjustment ticket and notify account owner.
priya-partners: also need to notify CloudMart partner PM so they fix their producer. I'll take that.
marketplace-bot: note: metric created: meter.unit_mapping_errors (count) and meter.mapped_events (count).
alex-gm: sequence: hotfix to staging -> run 48h backfill in dry-run -> apply with tickets. Target: patch + runbook by EOD today.
tom-eng: starting branch `feat/cloudmart-mscpu-mapping`. Adding unit conversion test and replay dry-run mode. Will wire DLQ to partner-replay queue.
leah-billing: please include a report template with: customer_id, original_value, mapped_value, billed_delta_usd, invoice_state. We'll need that for finance signoff.
priya-partners: partner comms draft: "We observed a unit encoding mismatch where `ms_cpu` was sent; we've mapped this to `cpu_seconds` on ingest and are running a reconciliation. No customer invoices have been issued yet; we'll reach out with any adjustments."
alex-gm: one more: ensure our aggregator rounding rules don't double-round after conversion. Use high-precision intermediate and round at final aggregation.
marketplace-bot: deploybot: staging deploy queued for feat/cloudmart-mscpu-mapping at 2091234038
deploy-bot: prod canary schedule pending approval after dry-run pass.
priya-partners: assigning: @tom-eng hotfix & tests; @leah-billing reconciliation + template; @alex-gm runbook + partner sync; @priya-partners partner comms.
leah-billing: will run dry-run and share CSV by 2091234200.
tom-eng: will ping when staging is green.
alex-gm: good work, team. keep the SI customers in the loop.
